## MC Hoster 3.0.0: the Community update

- **Two sides.** The name moved to the top, with two buttons: **Server hosting** (everything you had) and **Server sharing**.
- **Server sharing** is a board where you post about the servers you host and read what others post. It doesn't change your server.
- **Hosted servers** (new tab 8 in Server hosting): a list of servers people chose to list, with their icon, name and who made it. Click **List my server here** to add yours. Your IP is never shown.
- **Welcome window.** On first start you read and accept the terms, then pick the name other people see and your Minecraft username. You are made operator on every server you set up.
- **Send feedback** button in the Server tab. Only DarkerDawnFR can read it (the **Feedback inbox** button shows for him).
- **Update logs** button next to Check for updates: what was added or changed in every update.
- **My servers → Open** opens a server without starting it (Open & start still starts it).
- **Updating no longer crashes.** The new MC Hoster now opens by itself after an update.
- Fixes from 2.1.1: honest RAM on the players slider, and the "not enough memory" crash (32-bit Java).

The online parts (feedback, sharing, hosted list) need MC Hoster's online service. Until it is switched on they say so instead of working.
